name: How far in advance should I plan for fixture installation coordination?

mainEntity.name: How far in advance should I plan for fixture installation coordination?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is advisable to plan for fixture installation coordination as early as possible in your project timeline. Ideally, this should begin during the design and material selection phases, even before construction fully commences. Early planning allows sufficient time to order fixtures, especially custom or specialty items that may have long lead times, and to account for any design or compatibility issues. Engaging our coordination services early ensures that all fixture requirements are integrated into the overall project plan, preventing last-minute rushes, delays, and potential compromises on your desired selections. This proactive approach contributes significantly to a smooth and successful project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plan for fixture installation coordination as early as possible, ideally during design and material selection, to allow for ordering and prevent delays.
